name: The Rot-Stag
what: Act One, Relic-Bearer of Fawnrest, carrying the rotwood circlet. Gore, Trample, Rot Bellow, Antler Charge, Rotwood Crown.
about: Once the white stag of Fawnrest. A big shaggy white stag with the Rot eaten into him in dark purple patches, his lower legs gone dark to the hooves; great antlers wound with purple vines and sprouting mushrooms, and the golden rotwood circlet floating round them. 2.0 m to the antler tips.
